qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant energy management and automation ecosystem embedded in global data centers, commercial buildings, and industrial plants. High switching costs from proprietary hardware/software architectures (EcoStruxure, AVEVA) and deep contractor/specifier lock-in. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 14.6% with FCF conversion >100%. Primary erosion threats include cyclical downturns in European construction and potential supply chain bottlenecks in specialized power semiconductor components.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global champion in energy management, data center power systems, and industrial automation. High switching costs from EcoStruxure architecture and AVEVA software deliver 14.6% median ROIC and >100% FCF conversion. Balance sheet is strong with 12.4x interest coverage and net debt repayable in 2.5 years. [5-10Y g: data center and AI power demand 5.0% + industrial automation software 2.5% + net pricing power 1.5% - European construction cyclical drag 0.5% + net share repurchases 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Sales reached EUR 40.15B in FY2025 with EBIT of EUR 6.72B and Net Income of EUR 4.16B. GAAP ROIC has consistently exceeded the hurdle rate: 12.6% (FY22), 14.3% (FY23), 14.8% (FY24), and 14.9% (FY25), averaging 14.6% with tangible ROIC near 188%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is 104% (EUR 4.59B FCF in FY25 on EUR 1.54B capex). Balance sheet features EUR 4.63B in cash against EUR 15.02B in LT debt, yielding Net Debt / NI of 2.5x and interest coverage of 12.4x.
